message.content:
**Uno – Quick‑Start Rules** | Section | What you need to know | |---------|-----------------------| | **Goal** | Be the first player to score 500 points (or whatever house rule you set). Points are tallied from the cards left in opponents’ hands when you finish a round. | | **Players** | 2–10 (standard deck). | | **Deck** | 108 cards: 4 colors (Red, Yellow, Green, Blue) × 25 cards each (one 0, two 1–9, two “Skip”, two “Reverse”, two “Draw Two”) + 4 “Wild” + 4 “Wild Draw Four”. | | **Setup** | • Shuffle the deck.
• Deal 7 cards to each player.
• Place the remaining cards face‑down as the draw pile.
• Turn the top card of the draw pile face‑up to start the discard pile. If it’s a special card, apply its effect immediately (e.g., if it’s a “Draw Two”, the first player draws two and loses a turn). | | **Turn Order** | Players sit in a circle. The first player is the one to the left of the dealer. Turn order moves clockwise unless a “Reverse” card is played, which flips the direction. | | **Playing a Card** | On your turn you may play **one** card that matches either the **color** or the **number/symbol** of the top discard. If you have no playable card, you must draw one from the draw pile. If that drawn card is playable, you may play it immediately; otherwise, your turn ends. | | **Special Cards** | 1. **Skip** – Next player loses their turn.
2. **Reverse** – Reverses play direction.
3. **Draw Two** – Next player draws two cards and loses a turn.
4. **Wild** – You choose the new color.
5. **Wild Draw Four** – You choose the new color; next player draws four cards and loses a turn. (Can only be played if you have no other playable card; otherwise, the opponent may challenge you.) | | **Calling “UNO”** | When you play your **second‑to‑last** card, you must shout “UNO!” before the next player takes their turn. If you forget and another player catches you, you must draw two penalty cards. | | **Winning a Round** | The round ends when a player discards all of their cards. That player scores points equal to the sum of the values of the cards left in the other players’ hands: numbers = face value, Skip/Reverse/Draw Two = 20, Wild/Wild Draw Four = 50. | | **Winning the Game** | First player to reach 500 points (or your chosen target) wins. | --- ### Quick Tips 1. **Keep a mix of colors** – Having a variety of colors reduces the chance you’ll be stuck with a single color that you can’t play. 2. **Save “Wild Draw Four”** – Use it when you’re about to run out of cards or when you need to block an opponent’s win. 3. **Watch the discard pile** – If someone plays a “Draw Two” or “Wild Draw Four,” you can immediately play the same type if you have it, chaining the penalty. 4. **Challenge wisely** – Only challenge a “Wild Draw Four” if you’re sure the player had no matching color. A wrong challenge forces you to draw 4 cards instead of 2. Enjoy the fast‑paced, colorful fun of Uno!
